note: Starter values for comparing a model against a printing process. They are typical published design-guide figures rounded for a starting point, NOT standards and NOT a machine's real limits — override them with your own printer's numbers. Every row carries the basis it was taken from.

fdm.source: Typical FDM guidance: wall of about two 0.4 mm nozzle widths; overhangs beyond about 45 degrees from vertical usually need support. Machine- and material-dependent.

sla.source: Typical resin (SLA/DLP) design-guide minimum for a supported wall; supports are always required, so no overhang limit is given. Resin-dependent.

sls.source: Typical powder-bed (SLS) design-guide minimum wall; the powder bed supports overhangs, so no overhang limit is given. Material-dependent.

mjf.source: Typical Multi Jet Fusion design-guide minimum wall; overhangs are powder-supported, so no overhang limit is given. Material-dependent.

bambu-x1.source: Bambu Lab X1 published build volume
